items.q: How long does the program last?
items.a: The program runs over 8 weeks, with one session per week plus email support in between.

items.q: Are sessions online or in person?
items.a: Both options are available — choose what works best for you when you book.

items.q: Do I need any prior experience with coaching?
items.a: Not at all. The program is designed to meet you exactly where you are.

coachPage.title: About the Coach
coachPage.name: Manu
bio: Manu has spent over ten years helping people move from feeling stuck to feeling clear, confident and in charge of their own direction.
Her approach blends practical goal-setting with honest, human conversation — no jargon, no judgement, just real tools that work.
She believes lasting change happens in small, consistent steps, and her role is to walk alongside you as you take them.

programPage.title: About the Program
programPage.intro: A step-by-step coaching journey built to help you move from where you are to where you want to be.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: An 8-week, one-to-one coaching program combining weekly live sessions with practical tools you can use straight away.

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: Anyone who feels ready for change but isn't sure where to start — whether that's in your career, relationships, or sense of purpose.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Each week builds on the last: we set clear goals, work through what's holding you back, and track real progress together.

sections.heading: What you'll walk away with
sections.body: A clear personal roadmap, practical habits that stick, and the confidence to keep going after the program ends.
